description: Flood claim history (FEMA NFIP) — Flood-claim history for a US ZIP code or county from FEMA's National Flood Insurance Program: total NFIP claims, claims in the last 5 and 10 years, total/average/median paid, worst years, named flood events (e.g. Hurricane Katrina), flood-zone mix and a risk level (NO CLAIMS ON RECORD, LOW, MODERATE, HIGH, VERY HIGH). Params: zip= (5-digit ZIP) or county= (5-digit county FIPS). For real-estate, lending and insurance due diligence. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: realestate_flood_claims
